newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to cut April oil product wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to cut April oil product wholesale prices.

text.p: Japanese refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would lower its oil product wholesale prices by 1.8 yen per litre from its April shipments.
Following the cut, the wholesale price of gasoline will be 91.4 yen per litre, while kerosene and gas oil will be priced at 37.4 yen per litre, Idemitsu said in a statement.
The refiner said the move reflects a planned reduction in the import tariff on crude oil from April 1, and an easing trend in global crude prices.
Under a long-term programme, the Japanese government has decided to lower the import tariff on crude oil to 215 yen per kilolitre from fiscal 1997/98 starting on April 1, from 315 yen at present.
